name: sapling-patient-messaging
description: Sapling Family Clinic: two-way patient text messaging with a safe, context-aware staff-handoff agent (interview project).

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
